name: Tessa Brassbolt
exported_coordinate_units: centimeters in temporary independent copies; authoring source remains meters

textures.Normal: linear, tangent +Y, flat normal surface; geometric bevels

equipment: weighted within the skeletal mesh; socket bones also available

source_brief.silhouette: A compact upright body with a wide horizontal crossbow and a high single-lens goggle shape above the forehead. A short jacket flares just enough to contrast with the weapon bar.
source_brief.face: Freckled medium-brown skin, dark eyes, cropped copper hair and a confident grin. Goggles sit above the eyes during normal play so expressions remain visible.
source_brief.costume: Mustard work jacket over charcoal padding, leather forearm guards, sturdy trousers and broad boots. A few oversized straps suggest workshop practicality.
source_brief.equipment: A broad stylized crank crossbow with exaggerated fantasy housing and a circular side wheel. It is a game prop, not a functional construction plan; mechanisms remain decorative.
source_brief.signature: Horizontal crossbow silhouette, forehead goggles and mustard jacket.
source_brief.materials: Worn painted wood, brushed copper, matte leather and a tiny cool aiming-gem emissive point. Do not use transparent scope glass.
source_brief.back: A flat bolt case is strapped low between the shoulders; jacket seams form a large X. Keep all parts outside the elbows’ reload arc.
source_brief.animation: Idle checks the line of sight with a small tilt. Basics brace, fire and reset the bow. The active plants both feet, pulls the housing close and releases with a longer visible windup than a basic shot.
source_brief.vfx: A bright compact bolt with a short trail and a sharp target flash. It never pierces or explodes.
source_brief.audio: A dry mechanical click and compact fantasy bow thump; the active adds a short metallic accent rather than a firearm report.
source_brief.risk: The wide prop can overlap neighboring units. Use its lowered rest pose outside windup and a close-to-body turn pose.
